title: Cluster class file
description: One file <name>.yaml per cluster class (ADR-0037): in platform/cluster-classes/ for a class of provider any, in infra/providers/<provider>/cluster-classes/ for the class of one provider. Check NET-G17 reads it with tests/acceptance/sovereign/internal/suite/cluster_class.go, which applies exactly the keywords of this file and refuses a schema with any other.

name.description: The file name without the extension .yaml.

provider.description: any in platform/cluster-classes/, else the provider pack whose folder holds the file.

distribution.description: The Kubernetes distribution, for example k3s.

mayHostControlPlane.description: Whether a cluster of the class may run the Sovereign's control plane (ADR-0037 MC5).

capabilities.description: Every flag, true or false. Check NET-G17 probes every flag declared true; a flag declared false is not applicable.

policy.cilium.description: Cilium policies with entities and cluster-wide scope are enforced.

dataplane.kubeProxyFree.description: No kube-proxy runs; Cilium replaces it.

gateway.cilium.description: GatewayClass cilium accepts a Gateway that serves routes.

gateway.hostPort.description: Gateway listeners bind port 443 on the chosen nodes only.

node.daemonSets.description: Privileged DaemonSets on the host network run on every node.

lb.noNodePort.description: The public entry needs no node port. A class that needs one is not admitted (ADR-0026).

cilium.platformOwned.description: Flux installs and upgrades the Helm release cilium.
